pages.title: A Potion Has a Condition
pages.text: Test a special effect’s secondary result at its actual trigger.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Infested can release silverfish on damage; Ooze creates slimes after its bearer dies; Winded does not create a wind cloud and does not count for this goal. Weave interacts with attack-triggered webs. Use a suitable ordinary mob; player death is unnecessary.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Infested, Ooze and Weave qualify through their damage, death or attack triggers. Winded does not create the required wind cloud.
